title: Deep learning assists capsule endoscopy reading in a multicenter prospective validation
summary: In 330 capsule endoscopy videos from 3 devices across 7 centers in 4 countries, AI-assisted reading detected 605 of 635 consensus lesions versus 354 for standard reading (detection rate 96.1% vs 76.3%; sensitivity 97.5% vs 78.2%). A deep learning model detected and differentiated pleomorphic small-bowel lesions, applied by an independent expert after conventional reports. The reference was an expert consensus, and the comparison is of reader-assist versus conventional reading.
ai_technology: Deep learning model detecting and differentiating pleomorphic small-bowel lesions in capsule endoscopy videos
organization: Sao Joao University Hospital; University of Porto

evidence.unknown: Effect on patient outcomes and reading time, and bias from an expert consensus reference; full text not reviewed.
